description: As a load planner, I want to generate a weight and balance report for a flight so that the aircraft loading configuration is within safe limits.

acs.text: The report includes total payload weight, fuel weight, and empty aircraft weight.
The report calculates the center of gravity (CG) position as a percentage of the Mean Aerodynamic Chord (MAC).
The report displays a WITHIN LIMITS or EXCEEDS LIMITS status based on the CG calculation result.
The completed report can be exported as a PDF.

questions: Q-TCG001-001: AC-3 refers to CG limits but the story does not define what those limits are or where they come from. Are the limits stored per aircraft type? Per flight? Is there a regulatory table? This is required to define pass/fail criteria for test cases covering AC-3.
